name: v1.1.14 Slack Reply and Usage-Limit Fixes
goal: Thread a Brain reply split across messages under the operator's message, make no-reply acknowledgements visible in the operator's thread (reply owns closure), surface an opus-fallback usage limit honestly (alert, no liveness credit, no timeout restarts, heartbeat state), and release v1.1.14.
